scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --target browser --format esm --sourcemap --outdir ./dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --target browser --format cjs --sourcemap --outdir ./dist-cjs && mv ./dist-cjs/index.js ./dist/index.cjs && mv ./dist-cjs/index.js.map ./dist/index.cjs.map && rm -rf dist-cjs && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
